# Apple Education Community

> > A professional learning community where educators collaborate, share resources, and develop skills for teaching with iPad, Mac, and Apple technologies.

The Apple Education Community provides educators with access to the Apple Teacher learning program, lesson resources, teaching tutorials, and a collaborative forum. It serves as the central hub for professional development and peer support for teachers using Apple products in educational settings.

## Key Topics

- Apple Teacher
- iPad in education
- Mac in education
- Professional learning
- Educator collaboration
- Lesson resources
- Teaching tutorials
- Educational technology
- Learning Center
- Educator community
- Apple Teacher certification
- Classroom technology integration

## Community Hub

- [Education Community - Apple Education Community](https://education.apple.com/): Apple Education Community hub for educators using iPad, Mac & Apple Teacher
